|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another [[Jawa]], your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be cancelled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = the number of deserts you control with a Jawa.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-p5-30-Het_Nkik-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The original is [[Het Nkik (V)]]; the current text is [[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' ([[Het Nkik (V)]]): Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet, official text as of 11 May 2012<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p5-30-Het_Nkik.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hetnkik-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 9) prints this text again, identical character for character<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. An exact reprint of an earlier text is a stale reprint: it is not a new version and does not make this text current again (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, from 21 July 2012 (the earliest archived capture with game text): on the Virtual Block 8 list until that list changed (by 12 December 2012), and on the Virtual master list in every capture to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_29-e1">Players Committee website card list: VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be cancelled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = the number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” '''What changed:''' “canceled” is spelled “cancelled”, and “the” is added before “number of deserts”. The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Het Nkik (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 8 list, from the capture of 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_29-e2">Players Committee website card list: VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = the number of deserts you control with a Jawa.” '''What changed:''' “cancelled” is spelled “canceled” again; the rest is the PC-E1 text. From 12 December 2012 to at least 11 January 2013 the two lists showed different texts at the same time (PC-E1 on the Virtual master list, PC-E2 on the Virtual Block 8 list), so the two versions overlap. No card image shows either text; PC-E2 is the latest because it is the later change (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026).
